newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Morococha soars on dividend rumor.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Morococha soars on dividend rumor.

text.p: Peruvian miner Morococha jumped 10.09 percent by late trading on the Lima Stock Exchange due to rumors of an imminent dividend announcement.
"Everyone is betting on Morococha due to rumors about a possible dividend and positive first half financial balances," said Manuel Torres, of Finvest brokerage.
Morococha rose 10.05 percent to 8.29 soles soon after midday/1700 GMT on volume of 381,500 shares.
The company is Peru's second largest zinc producer and the sixth largest producer of lead concentrates.
